name: @personal-agent/storage
description: Transactional SQLite storage for Scheme B: one connection with a savepoint UnitOfWork, the extracted domain aggregate tables, command/fact receipts, a gap-free event log, the durable queue store, the native dispatch ledger, channel outbox receipts, answer deliveries, content-addressed artifacts with orphan GC, backup/restore, checksummed migrations, and the single-writer lock. Domain SQL and queue semantics are extracted from the upstream dsh-superagent prototype (MIT, DeepSeek Harness Team).
